thread:
maya: FYI kicked off v4-int6 A/B @ 1% vs v4fp16 at 10:00 UTC. initial perf looks nice (P95 -28%) but we have a fidelity_score delta on the code-doc slice.
darren: saw that too. fidelity_score (our composite: MRR*0.6 + QA_f1*0.4) is -4.7% on code-docs (>=1.5k tokens). global fidelity -0.9%.
zheng: curious if this is a quant-induced token merge in the tokenizer output or an attention drift. quick spot-check: generated diffs show missing inline references in multi-file prompts.
maya: samples in s3://redwood-evals/1712348001/v4-int6/sample-diffs.txt — some examples look like off-by-one tokenization at indentation boundaries.
deploy-bot: [ab_report] v4-int6@1%: latency p95 -28%, median -35%, fidelity_score -4.7% (code-doc), hallucination +1.1% abs (code-doc), global_fidelity -0.9%. full: s3://redwood-evals/1712348001/v4-int6/report.html
natalie: policy reminder: auto-fallback rules currently: fidelity_score delta <= -5% (slice) OR hallucination >=2% abs -> immediate rollback. but that was tuned on chat slices.
eng-oncall: recommend escalation ladder: for traffic <2% we treat these as "investigate" not auto-rollback unless fidelity_delta <= -10% on any critical slice. for traffic >=2% enable auto-fallback at fidelity_delta <= -5%.
darren: also propose a "fidelity ramp" where we require slice-stable signal across two windows before rollback: e.g., sustain >=20m across a 45m observe window to avoid flapping.
zheng: technical note: int6 kernel uses different softmax scaling; might be amplifying subtle prompt boundary errors. I can run a tokenizer-agnostic eval (byte-level align) to confirm.
maya: proposed quick mitigation: restart canary with auto-fallback disabled but add a high-sampling shadow run at 5% to collect more long-code samples. That lets us collect signal without immediate rollback.
natalie: agree. config I will apply:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v4-int6 --traffic 0.8% --observe 45m --auto-fallback "enabled=false" --notes "shadow-sample-long-code"
rwctl watch add --slice code-doc --metrics fidelity_score,hallucination --window 45m --sustain 20m
```
maya: will also enable a shadow at 5% for sample capture:
```
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v4-int6 --traffic 5% --mode sampling --slices code-doc,long-doc
```
zheng: I'll run the byte-aligned tokenizer eval and post results in ~40m. if it points to token boundary merges, we might try reapplying asymmetric quant scale for the embedding projection or tune logits rescale.
darren: decision on pager: keep pager for fidelity_delta <= -8% global or hallucination >=4% abs sustained 10m. otherwise slack alert.
eng-oncall: copy. I'll escalate if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: [action] rollout rlt-1712348001 created by natalie: canary 0.8% observe=45m auto-fallback disabled for initial ramp. shadow sampling at 5% enabled.
maya: thanks. keep posts concise— only new telemetry or explicit rollback requests. reconvene 10:50 UTC or sooner if deploy-bot flags auto-roll actions.
